facts.quote: Some American patients with stage 4 lung cancer travel to Cuba to receive CIMAvax , a therapeutic immunotherapy vaccine developed by Cuba's Center of Molecular Immunology.
facts.approval: Developed by Cuba's Center of Molecular Immunology. Not approved by the US FDA.
facts.availability: The US embargo bans the import of Cuban medicines; patients travel through third countries or carry refrigerated doses back. US clinical trials at Roswell Park, Buffalo, New York.
facts.note: Targets the epidermal growth factor (EGF) that lung cancer cells need; manages the cancer as a chronic condition, without the toxicity of chemotherapy.

facts.price: US brand Revlimid: $900 to $1,000 per pill. Indian generic: $0.30 to $3.00 per pill.
facts.approval: The US FDA approves generic lenalidomide and many Indian plants; patents and market exclusivity, not chemistry, keep the generic out of the US.
facts.availability: Some American patients order through Canadian pharmacies that route orders to Indian manufacturers.
